## Sep 24 Recap: When You Trust Your Stuff

Seven wins out of twelve picks—that's the kind of day where you pound the zone and let your defense work. From the mound, I always knew the difference between nibbling and attacking. Yesterday, our model attacked and came away with a 58.3% win rate. Not perfect, but in September baseball when every game matters, I'll take that success rate all day.

## What Worked, What Didn't

The Diamondbacks and Braves picks both came in at 61% confidence—one hit, one missed. That's baseball. From a pitcher's perspective, you can execute the same pitch twice and get completely different results. The Coors Field factor worked in our favor with Arizona, but Atlanta couldn't get it done against Cincinnati.

Our lower-confidence picks—Rangers at 50%, Sox at 52%, Astros at 52%—all came through. Sometimes the close ones are where you find value, especially late in the season when bullpens are gassed and matchups get weird.

## Tomorrow's Top Pick: Red Sox vs Cubs

Let's talk pitching matchups, because that's where Sep 25 gets interesting. Clay Holmes takes the ball for the Cubs traveling to Fenway, facing Alec Gamboa for Boston. Our model likes the Red Sox at 58% confidence, and from a pitcher's perspective, I can see why.

Fenway in late September—the wind patterns change, the ball doesn't carry like summer, and home arms who know that park have a real edge. Gamboa gets to work with that Green Monster in left, and visiting pitchers always need an adjustment period. Holmes is solid, but this is a spot where home field and familiarity matter.

## The Pitcher's Perspective

When I was throwing, September games had a different feel. Arms are tired, but the mental game sharpens. The Red Sox are at home, and Gamboa knows every sight line, every background, every way the ball moves in that ballpark. That's worth runs.

The Cubs are grinding through a road trip late in the season—that's when travel fatigue shows up in launch angles and bat speed. I'm riding with Boston tomorrow. Trust your home starter when he's got the park knowledge and the model backing him at 58%.

Let's build on yesterday's seven wins and keep attacking the zone.
